text: Research | Decart Research Publications Blog Technion Program Events Community tools Research How Much Can We Optimize? At Decart, research is measured by what it makes possible. We advance the science of doing more with the compute already available. Every advancement feeds directly into what we build, making our models faster, more efficient, and more capable. Publications Learning a Spatial Memory Codec for Video World Models Store the whole journey compactly, and read only what each view needs. Each view reads a few learned entries, even from archives of nearly two hours. Research Oct 2026 Step-Wise Refusal Dynamics in Autoregressive and Diffusion Language Models Diffusion language models are markedly harder to jailbreak than comparable autoregressive models. We show the difference is tied to the way they generate text, and turn that finding into SRI Guard, a jailbreak detector that matches or outperforms existing defenses at 0.01–0.04% overhead. Research Sep 2026 Original Full edit What if video editing had a volume knob? Text-driven video editing lets you describe what to change. But what about how much? We introduce Adaptive-Origin Guidance (AdaOr), a method that turns edit intensity into a smooth, continuous slider. Research Feb 2026 Our goal AI that perceives and reacts as fast as the world does. Live is the standard every line of our research is solving for Research pillars 01 Lucy Live Video Object and background replacement Consistency under motion and across frames Virtual try-on that preserves logos fit and detail Support for new input types and camera angles Live VFX and selective editing 02 Oasis Physical AI Short- and long-horizon memory Physical accuracy in object interaction Proprioception (spatial self-awareness) Object interaction 03 DOS / Cogito Compute Efficiency Higher throughput lower latency Longer context support Faster time-to-first-token Higher output per chip 04 Origin Foundational Models Improved text generation Postures and images with specific styling Models optimized for the DOS stack Controllable image generation Live AI is not just a speed benchmark; it is a fundamental paradigm shift. When hardware and representation learning evolve together, AI ceases to be an offline tool and becomes a continuous, interactive reality.
